verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Babylon.js runs transparently on WebGL 1.0, WebGL 2.0 and WebGPU, and ships as NPM packages with tree-shakable ES6 modules to trim payload; npm activity confirms a live, maintained core package. Payload is the weak point: a community user reports it is about three times the size of Three.js and needs bandwidth optimization, while older reports of slow scene loading were answered with incremental loading. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of WebGPU maturity, concrete bundle-size figures showing tree-shaking yields a reasonable payload.
